columns.name: content_kind
columns.semantic_note: one of: 'post', 'story', 'reel', 'archived_post', 'other' — which export category this row came from

columns.name: caption
columns.semantic_note: native, the project owner's own caption — may be null (many stories/reels have none)

columns.name: media_uri
columns.semantic_note: relative path into the raw export's media/ folder — a reference only, the file itself is never read or interpreted by this ingest

columns.name: media_index_in_group
columns.semantic_note: position of this media item within its post/carousel — 0 for the first

columns.name: latitude
columns.semantic_note: native GPS from the post's own metadata, present only on some geotagged posts (see module docstring, finding 2) — null otherwise, never inferred

columns.name: post_timestamp
columns.semantic_note: canonical timestamp — native, ISO 8601 UTC; group-level creation time when the export shape provides one, otherwise this media item's own
